title: Gaclib — C++ interfaces, from desktop to terminal

text.hero-title:
One C++ UI.
Many ways to render.
text.hero-description: Build interfaces with declarative layouts, rich controls, and reactive data binding. Gaclib brings your C++ application to desktop windows, terminal cells, and the browser.
text.examples-eyebrow: 01 / A little code, a working interface
text.examples-description: Describe a window in XML. Arrange its controls. Connect their properties with an expression.
text.examples-note: Interactive browser illustrations of the XML instances shown above. These previews reproduce the behavior in HTML; the linked guide explains how to build and run the C++ application.
text.platforms-description: Real screenshots from the platform repositories. Explore graphical and terminal renderers, then pick a color theme.
text.start-description: Build your first window, explore the manual, or start with an existing example.
text.features-title: The pieces for a complete application.
text.features-description: Use C++ directly, describe your UI in XML, and choose the parts of the library your application needs.
text.footer-text: Gaclib · C++ libraries by vczh and contributors.

hello.caption: An Easy Layout window with an OK button. Click to close it.
hello.code:
<Instance ref.CodeBehind="false"
          ref.Class="demo::HelloWindow">
  <Window ref.Name="self" Text="Hello, world!"
          ClientSize="x:320 y:160">
    <ez:Layout Padding="16">
      <ez:Fill>
        <Label Text="Welcome to Gaclib."/>
      </ez:Fill>
      <ez:Bottom>
        <ez:Right>
          <Button Text="OK"
            ev.Clicked-eval="{ self.Close(); }"/>
        </ez:Right>
      </ez:Bottom>
    </ez:Layout>
  </Window>
</Instance>

preview.heading: Welcome to Gaclib.
preview.closedMessage: Window closed. That's your first interaction.

binding.caption: Edit the name. The bound greeting updates with every keystroke.
binding.code:
<Instance ref.CodeBehind="false"
          ref.Class="demo::GreetingWindow">
  <Window Text="Say hello"
          ClientSize="x:360 y:180">
    <ez:Layout Padding="16">
      <ez:Top>
        <Label Text="Your name"/>
      </ez:Top>
      <ez:Top>
        <SinglelineTextBox ref.Name="nameInput"
                           Text="world"/>
      </ez:Top>
      <ez:Top>
        <Label
          Text-format="Hello, $(nameInput.Text)!"/>
      </ez:Top>
    </ez:Layout>
  </Window>
</Instance>

features.title: Easy, adaptive layouts
features.description: Arrange controls with docking, proportional space, and grids. Responsive compositions can switch views as the window changes size while preserving shared controls.

features.title: Reactive data binding
features.description: Bind control properties to expressions and C++ view models. Observable property changes update the interface; bindable lists, trees, and grids connect collections to controls.

features.title: Workflow scripting
features.description: Use an embedded language that works with registered C++ classes and interfaces. Workflow supports observable expressions, coroutines, and state machines, with runtime execution or C++ output.

features.title: XML to C++
features.description: Describe windows, resources, animations, and localized strings in XML. Generate C++20 source to link into your application without requiring runtime reflection for the generated interface.

features.title: Templates and styles
features.description: Replace a control's appearance with a control template, customize collection items with item templates, and share XML property settings through XPath-like style selectors.

features.title: Rich controls and documents
features.description: Build with trees, lists, editable data grids, menus, ribbons, and rich text. Virtual list controls create visual items for the visible part of a collection.

features.title: Runtime localization
features.description: Define translated strings in one resource and bind them to the interface. Changing the active locale updates text and supports localized date, time, and number formatting.

features.title: Declarative animation
features.description: Describe animated state in XML and bind its numeric or color fields to control properties. Choose interpolation functions to control how values change over time.

features.title: Remote protocol
features.description: Separate the application from its renderer. A headless C++ core sends rendering commands to a native client or GacJS in a browser through a configurable transport.
